analysis.reason: 최근 5거래일 연속 음봉 마감, 일봉 RSI 32.9로 과매도 구간 진입. MACD 히스토그램은 20092에서 -3201로 악화되며 약세 수렴 중. ADX 23.2로 추세 형성 초기 단계이나 -DI가 +DI보다 높아 하락 우위 지속. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 2.29로 급증했으나 하락 추세 강화. 볼린저밴드 하단에 근접한 1,116,699원 지지선 확인 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: The stock has closed with consecutive negative candles for the last 5 trading days, and the daily RSI has entered the oversold territory at 32.9. The MACD histogram has worsened from 20092 to -3201, indicating a bearish convergence. ADX is in the early stages of trend formation at 23.2, but -DI is higher than +DI, suggesting continued downside bias. The volume ratio compared to the 5-day average is 2.29, showing a surge in volume accompanying the strengthening downtrend. Confirmation of support at the lower Bollinger Band of 1,116,699 is required.
